## How the math works

Divide the ethanol price by the gasoline price. If the result is below 0.70,
ethanol costs less per kilometer in a car that follows the general rule. With
both consumption values, the calculator uses your own ratio.

## Worked example

With gasoline at BRL 6.29 and ethanol at BRL 4.19, the ratio is about 0.67, so
ethanol tends to be cheaper.

## A note on Brazilian prices

Prices are in Brazilian reais per liter, and the pump price already includes
the anhydrous ethanol blended into gasoline.
